shows.title: The Institute
shows.overview: When 14 year old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won’t last, as his story and Luke’s are destined to collide.

shows.title: MobLand
shows.overview: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

shows.title: VisionQuest
shows.overview: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

shows.title: Black Doves
shows.overview: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

shows.title: Dexter: Resurrection
shows.overview: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

shows.title: Campus Drivers
shows.overview: Lois arrives in Belrose with Max, the love of her life. Lane, the creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, is known for never getting attached. Their paths were never meant to cross. But some encounters change everything, reopening old wounds. And when love appears unexpectedly, nothing is certain anymore.

shows.title: The Remarried Empress
shows.overview: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

shows.title: Lupin
shows.overview: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

shows.title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
shows.overview: Twenty years after City of God, Buscapé recounts how conflicts between police, traffickers, and militias impacted the community.

shows.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
shows.overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.
